adapter_provenance.method: Independent dispositions and dimension rationales copied unchanged; source paths bound to evidence IDs

reliability.rationale: The positive proposed claim is not admitted. The selected forecast has condition-mean MAE 0.0659579 in signed polarization, worse than current-state persistence 0.0657186 and flexible 0.0647465. Worst-condition error also fails to improve on persistence. Unsupported predictive superiority and a supported informative failure are appropriate.

mechanism.rationale: Position-derived causal polarization is a collective geometric response, not a measurement of a universal individual turning tendency. Country-condition repetitions are linked, but participant reuse across conditions is unknown; trial calibration and only five held conditions limit transfer.

novelty.rationale: Known source analyses and standard mathematical/statistical families are disclosed. This review does not certify a new law or exhaustive novelty.

significance.rationale: Useful reproduction and falsification of a compact crowd-memory hypothesis, with source-smoothed velocities excluded and original bias findings disclosed.

reproducibility.rationale: Native adapter, frozen equations, coefficients and compact evidence were inspected. Separate computational review performs numerical replay; scientific review is not experimental replication.

impact.rationale: No independent deployed intervention, measured cost benefit or external experimental replication establishes industrial impact.

checks: Case-specific endpoint semantics and prior-art review
Predictor timing and calibration budget review
Named-control comparisons and negative evidence reviewed
No inference of novelty from fit quality
limitations: Within-source group-rotation temporal dynamics after observed prefix. Centroid-based XY-derived order differs from authors supplied Pol; no arithmetic identity predicted at same time. Source published conditionmeans already known; confirmation not unseen-world evidence. No novel biological handedness or safety intervention law.
Agent review is advisory, not independent experimental replication.
